purpose: Existing connection A owns zero-only control; distinct non-owner connection B requests DISARM, revokes owner, receives result and leaves both sessions IDLE.

native_cases: ACTIVE owner, B without ticket stops and receives matching result after ACK/TEL
A queued CMD cancelled before UART on B stop
A in-flight CMD cancelled and DISARM follows
pc_evidence.scope: Mocks for browser/server responses and native RTOS/UART; no board/electrical claim

script_behavior.installation: Creates B and sends HELLO only; does not alter A send or PAGE control timers
script_behavior.trigger: User clicks normal page ARM after B READY
script_behavior.b_stop: One ticket-free DISARM after A ARM OK, >=2 zero CMD OK, fresh ARMED/zero and both ACTIVE snapshots with A owner
script_behavior.confirmation: B accepted notice + OK + matching stopped TEL independently; account for identified A followup DISARM with accepted/OK; newest matching stopped TEL, both IDLE and 3.1s stable observation
script_behavior.failure: Retain INCOMPLETE; one fallback DISARM if potentially armed; no ARM/CMD replay
script_behavior.page_result_note: A may send a protective DISARM on a racing CMD rejection; helper records it without suppressing PAGE behavior.

required_evidence: Matching capture with A ARM/zero CMD then CAN+LF/DISARM/ACK/new stopped TEL
ESP monitor covering before ARM through stop
remaining: Revised helper has not been bench-run; immediate rerun is not required for the already evidenced bounded non-owner DISARM criterion.
Non-owner ARM rejection and wider AC-S02 scopes are separate.
limits: Uses two WebSocket sessions within one focused page to avoid hidden/blur stopping A before B; not a two-device RF test.
Does not test non-owner ARM rejection or the entire AC-S02 suite.
No nonzero motor command or powered-motor stopping performance claim.
original_browser_verdict: INCOMPLETE preserved; followup DISARM accounting defect
